appliedState.windows_policy: Listed times are availability facts, not physiological spacing minima. No overlapping sessions; exact durations/budgets must fit each named window.

planned_adaptation_envelope.accepted_branch: User may stop or omit optional work; exact conditional branch must be part of accepted session
planned_adaptation_envelope.coupling: No simultaneous escalation of duration, intensity and density. Executing accepted recipe variation is not new mutation.
planned_adaptation_envelope.outside_branch: New dose or move is a versioned B proposal and needs support, not only consent

planned_distribution.note: No cross-sport summed fatigue/load score. Warmup, run work/recovery and strength work sets remain separate dimensions.
